meta.title: Software project documents
meta.description: Generate, rebuild and fill gaps in the 18 software R&D project-management documents (DOCX): confirm the document list and working mode first, then rebuild non-conforming documents from extracted facts and identify missing documents per project phase. One typography spec covers cover page, revision history, table of contents, numbered headings, tables and figures; template mode adds italic fill-in guidance and examples; every revision produces a new versioned file with a formal revision record.
